description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization providing clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. The Shiny App Developer will support Clinical Informatics initiatives by evaluating data needs, developing and validating data products, interacting with clinical data, and contributing to process improvement.
Shiny application developer building study data products and analyzing relational data for clinical research

Responsibilities:
• Evaluate data needs for assigned projects and make recommendations on strategic approach specific to the study design
• Work alongside operational and medical leads to contribute innovative data products (primarily Shiny applications)
• Interact with relational data at both study- and enterprise-level inclusive of actions for query, wrangling, analysis, and reporting; and
• Support departmental process improvement initiatives

Requirements:
• Bachelor's in informatics, computer science/engineering, biomedical engineering, health information, statistics, or related field
• Analytical thinker with great attention to detail
• Ability to prioritize multiple projects on a sprint schedule
• Excellent verbal communication skills
• Programming experience in R or Python
• Work experience with clinical data
• Experience building Shiny web applications

Preferred:
• Experience building dashboards is preferred (with either PowerBI, Tableau, or Spotfire)
